Repository: Himalayas Browser - Agent-Native Operating System
================================================================================

DESCRIPTION (for GitHub "About" section - max 125 chars):
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
The world's first truly agent-native browser platform. Agents are native citizens.

LONGER DESCRIPTION (for website link):
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Himalayas Browser is an agent-native operating system built on Rust. Unlike
traditional browsers where automation is bolted on, Himalayas is fundamentally
designed from the ground up for autonomous agents. Agents are first-class citizens,
the GUI is optional, and privacy is enforced by architecture—not settings.

Perfect for government automation, enterprise RPA, privacy-conscious users,
and developers who need a headless-first browser platform.

KEY FEATURES (for README):
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
✅ Agent-Native Architecture - Agents are first-class citizens
✅ Headless-First Design - Runtime primary, GUI optional
✅ Privacy by Architecture - Ephemeral by default, no tracking
✅ AI Document Platform - PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint processing
✅ Adaptive Intelligence - Auto-detects device, adapts at runtime
✅ Keyboard-Driven - 50+ customizable shortcuts
✅ Multi-Workspace - Organize by context
✅ Spatial Intelligence - Multi-GNSS, location memory
✅ Production Ready - 218 tests, 100% passing
✅ Multi-Platform - Windows, macOS, Linux (x86_64, ARM64)
